mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notify_pref (tenant_id, user_id, type, in_app, dingtalk) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{inApp}, #{dingtalk})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notify_pref WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE notify_pref SET in_app = #{inApp}, dingtalk = #{dingtalk} WHERE id = #{id}
